question: How much durian does Thailand grow?

output.message: FAOSTAT counts it inside the item Other tropical fruits, n.e.c., with 30 other crops of the atlas: there is no figure for it alone, in any country.

answer: FAOSTAT counts durian inside the item Other tropical fruits, n.e.c., with 30 other crops of the atlas: there is no figure for it alone, in any country [S1].
